synopsis: The NSW Resources Regulator’s guidance addresses vehicle interaction controls in mines in New South Wales, Australia [f2786]. Its materials include a July 2022 compliance priorities report on proximity awareness and collision avoidance in open-cut coal, a September 2023 discussion paper, a draft Technical Reference Guide, and a May 2025 fact sheet on collisions involving remote-controlled equipment [f2266, f2264, f2785, f2267]. However, the guidance prescribes no testing requirements, and the Technical Reference Guide remains a draft, leaving a gap for validation planning [f2787]. The regulator recorded 30 LHD and personnel-transport collisions in NSW underground coal mining in the 12 months to mid-2025 [f3196]. It also reported in 2023 that collision technology was viewed as a “silver bullet,” raising concern about over-reliance rather than establishing that technology alone resolves collision risk [f3417].
